question: Press reads, batch B: what each in-scope row of Summary, Summary (Size and Spacing), Archive changes on the block.
how: Run f70 on the oracle: per block, Exit Without Saving, Edit on Blocks Probe, a blank section, Add Block and the block by name, Edit, then each step by a named press with an on-top check (a switch by its aria-label, a button by its label, a field by Cmd+A, Backspace and keys then Tab, a menu by its row then an option). The block (area, size, every visible leaf box) is read before and after each step. No row that makes something outside the block, opens a service, or reaches a store or payments was pressed. Left by Exit Without Saving; the page read 0 blocks at the end.

Summary.note: Design, one run (f70, second Summary run; the first run's block reads were overwritten by a probe slip, its log agrees on every row change except the count). Number of Items typed 5: the after read was taken before the rows moved (12); the next read shows 20 rows (the lost first run read 23: the sample items differ between runs, so their heights do too). Left, Center, Right Aligned: rows stay. Title off 18 rows, on 20; Featured Image off 6, on 20; Excerpt off 16, on 20. Metadata Position lists Above Title, Below Title, Below Content; Above Title picked: rows stay. Layout menu lists Wall, Carousel, List, Grid; Carousel picked: 5 rows.
